integrity: Proof is by exact lattice-layer counts and Pick theory; 3388 exact finite tests corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns two-factor joins with one lattice segment and another factor of dimension at most two; no general higher-dimensional join theorem is claimed.
The normalized-volume minima are for the specified join families, not all lattice polytopes of the given dimension.
The segment-length eight statement is existential over polygons. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp Ehrhart sign transitions for joins with lattice segments
